description: Authoritative reference of authentic Illumina TruSeq/Nextera UDI sequences. Used by tests/unit/test_barcode_authenticity.py to assert that the version-controlled manifest (illumina_udis_v1.0.0.json) contains only genuine, doc-verified sequences (set membership).
source_document_status: RETRIEVED — index tables transcribed from doc 1000000002694 (Illumina Adapter Sequences, v01).

notes: TruSeq-8base and Nextera-8base are the genuine 8-base i7 sample-sheet indices from doc 1000000002694 (TruSeq HT D701-D712; Nextera XT Index Kit v2 N70x).
TruSeq-10base and Nextera-10base are the genuine 10-base Illumina Unique Dual (UD) Index i7 sample-sheet indices from doc 1000000002694 (Illumina UD Indexes, Tagmentation, Set A).
UD indexes are universal (validated and used with both TruSeq and Nextera tagmentation libraries); the TruSeq/Nextera set labels denote intended kit compatibility, not a distinct sequence space.
Every sequence below was verified against the corresponding index table in doc 1000000002694.
All four sets maintain a minimum pairwise Hamming distance >= 3 (SRS FR-3.3.2), verified programmatically by tests/unit/test_barcode_authenticity.py.

TruSeq-8base.description: Illumina TruSeq HT 8-base i7 UDI indices (D701-D712) per doc 1000000002694 (TruSeq HT Kits, Index 1 (i7) Adapters).

Nextera-8base.description: Illumina Nextera XT Index Kit v2 8-base i7 UDI indices (N70x) per doc 1000000002694 (Nextera XT Index Kit v2, Index 1 (i7) Adapters).

TruSeq-10base.description: Illumina Unique Dual (UD) Indexes, Tagmentation, Set A 10-base i7 sample-sheet indices (UDP0001-UDP0024) per doc 1000000002694 (Illumina Unique Dual Indexes). Compatible with TruSeq tagmentation libraries.

Nextera-10base.description: Illumina Unique Dual (UD) Indexes, Tagmentation, Set A 10-base i7 sample-sheet indices (UDP0025-UDP0046) per doc 1000000002694 (Illumina Unique Dual Indexes). Compatible with Nextera tagmentation libraries.
